PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-002
Title: Competitive Quotations
Version: 2.1
Effective Date: 2025-01-01
Category: quotations
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Quotation Requirements
1.1 Purchases up to USD 1,000 do not require a competitive quotation.
1.2 Purchases above USD 1,000 and up to USD 5,000 require at least one written
    quotation.
1.3 Purchases above USD 5,000 and up to USD 25,000 require at least three written
    quotations from different suppliers.
1.4 Purchases above USD 25,000 must be run as a formal tender.
2. Quotation Validity and Content
2.1 Quotations must remain valid for at least 30 days from the date of the purchase
    request.
2.2 Quotations must show the supplier name, a quotation number, itemised prices and the
    currency.
2.3 Quotations that contain arithmetic errors must be corrected by the supplier before
    they can be used.
3. Exceptions
3.1 A single-source purchase above USD 1,000 requires a written sole-source
    justification approved by the procurement officer.
3.2 Emergency purchases are exempt from the quotation requirements in section 1.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
